name: naturae
roots: natura (nasci, to be born); quid (something: the Stoics' highest genus in Seneca's 58th letter, divided into corporalia and incorporalia)

name: corpus
roots: corpus (a body; also a whole of writings); corporalia (Seneca: bodies, which are); quod tribus dimensionibus extenditur (what is extended in three dimensions)

name: dicibile
roots: dicere (to say); dicibile (Augustine, De dialectica 5: what the mind grasps in a word, before it is spoken); legere (to gather, to read — λέγω's kin)

name: natura
roots: nasci (to be born)

name: genus
roots: gignere (to beget): a kind as a birth-line

name: genera
roots: genus (a birth-line)

name: ordo corporum
roots: ordo (a row, a rank); gradus (a step); scala naturae (the ladder of nature)

name: particula elementaris
roots: particula (a little part); elementum (a first principle); minimum (Bruno: the least, without parts) — New Latin

name: hadronium
roots: ἁδρός (stout) — New Latin

name: nucleus
roots: nux (a nut): the kernel

name: atomus
roots: ἄτομος (uncut); primordia rerum, corpora prima, semina rerum (Lucretius: the first beginnings, the first bodies, the seeds of things)

name: molecula
roots: moles (a mass, a heap)

name: cellula
roots: cella (a small room, a store-chamber)

name: textus
roots: texere (to weave); tela (a web)

name: organum
roots: ὄργανον (a tool); membrum (a member)

name: systema organorum
roots: σύστημα; apparatus (made ready)

name: corpus animatum
roots: anima (breath, soul): a body with a soul — Aquinas's rendering of Aristotle's σῶμα ἔμψυχον

name: populus
roots: pŏpulus (a people) — pōpulus, the poplar, is another word; grex (a herd, a flock)

name: communitas
roots: communis (shared); munus (a duty, a gift)

name: oecosystema
roots: οἶκος (a household); domus (a house) — New Latin

name: biosphaera
roots: βίος + σφαῖρα — New Latin

name: materia
roots: materia (timber: the hard part of a tree; from mater)

name: saxum
roots: saxum (a rock, a boulder); lapis (a stone)

name: corpus caeleste
roots: caelum (the sky) + corpus

name: componens
roots: componere (to put together)

name: machina
roots: μηχανή (a contrivance); instrumentum (what is built in)

name: fabrica
roots: faber (a craftsman): a workshop, a structure; struere (to pile up, to build)

name: corona
roots: corona (a wreath, a garland)

name: Unus
roots: unus (one); Deus (from *deywós, the shining one of the sky — not kin to θεός, though alike)

name: caritas
roots: carus (dear, precious); caritas non quaerit quae sua sunt (1 Cor 13:5)

name: auctor
roots: augere (to make grow): the one through whom a thing grows; creator (creare, kin to crescere)

name: status
roots: stare (to stand)

name: dimensiones
roots: dimetiri (to measure out)

name: tempus
roots: tempus (a section, a season — perhaps from the root of τέμνω, to cut, as templum is a section of sky marked out)

name: longitudo
roots: longus (long)

name: quando
roots: quando (the category of when, in Boethius's Latin Categories)

name: ubi
roots: ubi (the category of where); locus (a place)

name: complementa
roots: complere (to fill up)

name: enuntiatum
roots: enuntiare (to speak out); enuntiatio (Cicero's rendering of the Stoic ἀξίωμα, a statement)

name: lator
roots: ferre, latum (to bear); subiectum (what is thrown under and bears)

name: systema
roots: σύστημα

name: divisio
roots: dividere (to part); punctum (a prick: the dot)

name: divisiones
roots: dividere

name: pars
roots: pars (a part); totum (the whole)

name: habitat in
roots: habitare (to keep having — the frequentative of habere): a habitat is where a being keeps itself

name: situs in
roots: situs (a position: the Latin name of Aristotle's category κεῖσθαι); locus (a place)

name: dominus
roots: domus (a house): the master of the house; proprietas (what is one's own)

name: sponsor
roots: spondere (to pledge solemnly); respondere (to answer, to pledge in return)

name: acta
roots: agere (to do)

name: factum
roots: facere (to make); verum et factum convertuntur (Vico: the true and the made are one)

name: derivatum
roots: derivare (to draw off a stream: rivus)

name: lectum
roots: legere (to gather, to pick out, to read)

name: dictum
roots: dicere (to say); dictum (Abelard: what a proposition says)

name: origo
roots: oriri (to rise); fons (a spring)

name: strata
roots: sternere (to spread out)

name: professio
roots: profiteri (to declare openly)

name: lex
roots: lex (perhaps from legere, what is read out); ius (what is right)

name: ratio
roots: reri (to reckon); ratio legis (the reason of the law)

name: diarium
roots: dies (a day); ephemeris (a day-book)

name: historia
roots: ἱστορία; annales (the year's record)

name: pendentia
roots: pendere (to hang): what still hangs undecided

name: nomina
roots: nomen (a name)

name: aspectus
roots: aspicere (to look at)

name: lentes
roots: lens, lentis (a lentil)

name: oriens
roots: oriri (to rise)

name: intellegere
roots: inter + legere (to choose between, to read between): understanding reads between the parts

name: opera
roots: opus (work); operari (to work)

name: inspectio
roots: inspicere (to look into); examen (the tongue of a balance)

name: hortus
roots: hortus (an enclosed garden — kin to cohors, an enclosure); paradisus

name: nomen
roots: nomen (a name)
